judgments.subject: interface.boundaries.claim.canonical-owner
judgments.conclusion: The existing App Server claim service remains the sole owner of grants, stable identity, immutable revisions, lineage, reliance, SQLite persistence, freshness, completeness, and read projection mechanics.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.operations-and-reliance
judgments.conclusion: Reviewers receive only bounded relevant exact revisions, projection provenance, explicit limitations, and a zero-authority envelope. They do not receive grants, operation envelopes, the canonical store, or instructions to emulate the registry.

judgments.subject: interface.boundaries.authority.no-review-verdict
judgments.conclusion: Finding profile records do not decide applicability, verdict, synthesis, acceptance, campaign phase, or builder reliance; those remain with the specialist, Implementation Review, Review Episode, builder, and supervisor according to their existing contracts.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.operations-and-reliance
judgments.conclusion: Native review composition uses stable owner operation and transition identities, publishes exact owner state before campaign CAS binding, and recovers partial success without claiming a cross-store transaction or creating another store.
